faces.transcription: Find card 52 in the Operations deck and place it faceup in the Operations area.
faces.flavor: "All right team, I gotta say I'm impressed. Sabik fed you his propaganda and you passed it along to me at some risk. Thank you; you got a bright future. Now, it's standard procedure for new operatives to get some restrictions in their first year; something to keep you on track, maybe challenge your methodology. But hey, I pulled a few strings and got you something you can work around. No need to hinder your good efforts."
